title.narrative: Promoting the Safe and Effective Use of Treated Wastewater and Sludge to Improve Soil Quality, Address Land Degradation, and Mitigate Climate Change

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

Socio-economic Benefits and Decent Rural Employment 88. This project is expected to generate significant socio-economic benefits for local communities in the Konya region. By improving soil quality and agricultural productivity through the safe reuse of treated wastewater and sludge, it will enhance food security and create new economic opportunities. The project will promote sustainable agricultural practices, which can lead to increased yields and income for farmers. Additionally, the development of green belts and other nature-based solutions will contribute to a healthier environment, improving the quality of life for residents. 89. The project places a strong emphasis on promoting decent rural employment by offering targeted training and capacity-building programs in sustainable land management and wastewater treatment technologies. Special attention will be given to engaging women and youth to ensure equitable access to knowledge, employment, and decision-making. These efforts will empower local communities and contribute to inclusive growth and poverty reduction in the region.
